001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.adapter;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import android.view.LayoutInflater;
005import android.view.View;
006import android.view.ViewGroup;
007import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
008import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter;
009import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.ViewHolder;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.ItemPinBinding;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
012import java.util.List;
013
014public class PinsAdapter extends Adapter<ViewHolder> {
015
016  private final LayoutInflater inflater;
017  private final List<Pin> pins;
018  private final OnLongClickListener listener;
019
020  public PinsAdapter(@NonNull Context context, @NonNull List<Pin> pins, @NonNull OnLongClickListener listener) {
021    this.pins = pins;
022    inflater = LayoutInflater.from(context);
023    this.listener = listener;
024  }
025
026  @NonNull
027  @Override
028  public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup viewGroup, int viewType) {
029    ItemPinBinding binding = ItemPinBinding.inflate(inflater, viewGroup, false);
030    return new Holder(binding, listener);
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
035    ((Holder) holder).bind(position, pins.get(position));
036    // done 2025-02-13 Invoke holder.bind with the object in 'position'.
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public int getItemCount() {
041    return pins.size();
042    // done 2025-02-13 Return the number of Pin instances that can be displayed in this view.
043  }
044
045  private static class Holder extends ViewHolder {
046
047    private final ItemPinBinding binding;
048    private final OnLongClickListener listener;
049
050    public Holder(@NonNull ItemPinBinding binding, @NonNull OnLongClickListener listener) {
051      super(binding.getRoot());
052      this.binding = binding;
053      // TODO: 2025-02-13 Initialize any fields.
054      this.listener = listener;
055    }
056
057    public void bind(int position, Pin pin) {
058      binding.title.setText(pin.getTitle());
059      binding.modifiedOn.setText(pin.getModifiedOn().toString());
060      // 2025-02-13 Use data from item to populate widgets in itemView.
061      binding.getRoot().setOnLongClickListener(view -> listener.onLongClick(view, pin, position));
062    }
063
064  }
065
066  @FunctionalInterface
067  public interface OnLongClickListener {
068    boolean onLongClick(View view, Pin pin, int position);
069  }
070}
